name: Vonit Launch
description: Launch a product you built: understand it, position it, pick channels, make the assets, reach people personally, run launch day, and keep going after.

reads: the product's site, repository or store page

stages.produces: go, or the one thing to fix first

person: confirm who it is for and the alternative
existing audience: list size, followers, communities

stages.produces: landing page fixes, screenshots, images, demo video, copy per channel, press kit
a personal list and individual messages
run sheet, posts out, every comment answered

never: send or post anything without the person's approval of the exact text and destination
ask for upvotes, use other accounts, or join vote rings
use bought, scraped or guessed contact lists
invent users, numbers, quotes, logos, press or reviews
